title: London's Bungalow Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Enjoy designer décor & a private king suite—all within a short stroll to Seaside’s beach, shops, dining, and recreational amenities.
description_expanded: Description486 FOREST STREET1 KINGDiscover the charm of London’s Bungalow, a beautifully designed one-bedroom guest cottage tucked along the quiet pathways of Seaside, Florida. This thoughtfully furnished retreat features high-end designer décor, a flexible two-level layout, and easy access to the iconic white-sand beaches and world-class amenities along Scenic Highway 30A.Second Floor – Kitchenette, Dining & LaundryExterior stairs lead to the second floor, where a stylish kitchenette includes an under-counter refrigerator, microwave, coffee maker, and a cozy dining area for two. A full bathroom with a glass-enclosed walk-in shower completes this level. This floor also includes a full-size washer and dryer, a rare luxury in Seaside’s guest cottages.Third Floor – Private King SuiteThe top floor features a serene king bedroom with designer furnishings, a flat-screen TV, a small closet, and a private full bath. Elevated above the treetops, this suite offers the perfect hideaway for couples seeking quiet and privacy.Location & Outdoor HighlightsThe guest cottage is tucked behind the main home, offering privacy while remaining close to everything Seaside has to offer. A rear gate opens to a sandy footpath that leads toward Seaside’s tennis courts, fitness center, and recreational amenities. The beach is just 352 yards away, an easy, scenic stroll along Seaside’s iconic brick streets. Beach toys for children are also provided.Why Guests Love London’s BungalowDesigner furnishings & curated coastal décorTwo-level layout offering exceptional privacyGreat for couples or small familiesWasher & dryer includedQuick walk to the beach, Seaside Amphitheater, shops & diningPerfect home base for exploring 30A, Seaside, WaterColor, and Grayton BeachWhether you’re planning a romantic getaway or a peaceful solo retreat, London’s Bungalow offers the comfort, charm, and convenience that make Seaside, Florida vacation rentals so unforgettable.* 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2-night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration.Features392 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion; 352 yards or a 2-minute walk to the beach; the largest private residential beach on 30AAccess to 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply and a fitness center.Welcome tote with 2 beach towels, a bottle of wine, and 2 rental bikes available to pick up at The Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided1 parking pass is issued. A golf cart is considered a car, and for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit.No pets allowed
